name: Facilitated Routines
author: Lucas Ferraz SEO

sections.description:
Facilitated Routines brings together useful routines for sites that publish a lot of content.
* Technical SEO automation
* Identify and remove broken links with one click
* Renames the featured image file to the title slug when publishing or updating.
* Bulk renames featured images.
* Cleans unused media with protection for site logo and icon.
* Finds posts without featured image and lists with edit link.
* Finds and removes broken images in content and featured images.
* Generates WebP versions when possible.
* WordPress adjustments with checkboxes: hide version, disable heartbeat, embeds, shortlink, dashicons on front, XML-RPC, feeds, global styles, emojis and more.
* Security tab to write .htaccess in uploads, wp-content and wp-includes and remove default readme
* Sitemap generation for posts, pages, custom post types, authors and news with automatic updates
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install through the panel.
  2. Activate in Plugins.
  3. Open Settings → Facilitated Routines to configure.
sections.faq:
Do routines have progress bar?

Yes. Long operations use paginated AJAX with counters to avoid timeout.

Can I disable specific features?

Yes. All features have checkboxes; check only what you need.

Does the plugin alter existing .htaccess rules?

No. We only write files marked with the plugin signature and do not overwrite third-party rules.

How do I completely uninstall?

Deactivate and delete the plugin. Options are removed via uninstall.php.
